name: Mento Kenyan Shilling
oneLiner: KESm is Mento's reserve-backed Kenyan shilling stablecoin on Celo, issued and retired through the oracle-priced USDm/KESm Broker pool.
collateral: Shared Mento Reserve: Mento's pinned analytics configuration classifies KESm as reserve-backed rather than CDP-backed. Its backing is the protocol's diversified, dynamically managed reserve, not USDm locked in a KESm-specific borrower trove.
pegMechanism: KESm is issued through Mento v2's USDm/KESm Broker and BiPoolManager exchange. A USDm-to-KESm swap burns incoming USDm and mints outgoing KESm; the reverse burns KESm and mints USDm. The virtual pool prices swaps from the KES/USD SortedOracles feed and applies spread, trading-limit, report-count, freshness, and BreakerBox checks.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Claude owner-ruling R2 Mento archetype application
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Owner ruling 2026-07-31 places Mento's protocol-reserve-backed FX inventory under the fiat-cash archetype umbrella, following the reserve-backed USDm/EURm precedent already recorded on cusd-celo and ceur-celo. KESm is minted and burned as reserve-backed inventory against the shared Mento Reserve through the Mento Broker at oracle rates: there is no borrower trove, no position health factor, and no liquidation path, so cdp remains inapplicable. Under this ruling fiat-cash reads as reserve-backed cash-equivalent inventory issuance rather than strictly custodial off-chain cash.

oracleRisk.summary: KESm's live Celo USDm/KESm Broker exchange uses one SortedOracles reporter with a 360-second report-expiry window and minimumReports set to one; BreakerBox gates swaps, but no second feed or automatic failover path is configured.

branchApplicability.rationale: At finalized Celo block 72780426 (2026-07-22T00:46:24Z), KESm broker() returned the Mento Broker and its sole exchange provider exposed exchange 0x89de88b8eb790de26f4649f543cb6893d93635c728ac857f0926e842fb0d298b pairing USDm with KESm. The pool used reference feed 0xbAcEE37d31b9f022Ef5d232B9fD53F05a531c169, a 360-second reset/expiry window, minimumReports 1, and one active SortedOracles reporter. The pinned backing config classifies KESm as reserve-backed, the pinned deployment registry has no KESm borrower branch, and the live reserve API listed debt-bearing troves only for GBPm, JPYm, and CHFm. KESm therefore has a Broker conversion-oracle path rather than borrower-specific oracle and liquidation branches to enumerate.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current holder-facing KESm token has no direct governance-controlled blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-account burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Broker/exchange burn and Celo-VM gas debiting are protocol-scoped, not governance holder-freeze controls. Timelocked proxy upgrade authority is recorded in mint-authority evidence but is not itself a currently executable holder-freeze surface. This direct conclusion does not suppress reserve-derived upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 at Celo block 74317848. KESm 0x456a3d042c0dbd3db53d5489e98dfb038553b0d0 still returned Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147 as owner, Broker 0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad, validators 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, and a zero exchange; its implementation remained verified StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e. Verified transfer paths have no blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, allowlist, or governance transfer hook. Broker/exchange burn is caller-scoped and debitGasFees is Celo-VM scoped. Mento governance can replace implementation only through the observed 172800-second timelock, so current direct blacklistability is false while deployment posture remains restrictable. USDC, USDT, EURC, and related shared-reserve exposures can impair backing but cannot restrict KESm balances and are therefore dependency risk, not an inherited direct-access verdict.

mintAuthority.summary: Operational KESm issuance runs through the Mento Broker, which burns the incoming Mento stable token and mints the outgoing token during USDm/KESm swaps. StableTokenV2 also authorizes the Celo ValidatorsProxy, but its current implementation only mints registry USDm for EpochManager; its Celo-Governance-owned proxy is therefore a latent upgrade-controlled KESm mint surface. exchange() is zero, and the two-day Mento Timelock can change token authorization slots and upgrade the KESm token and Broker.

controls.label: Mento Broker - operational KESm swap minter
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, broker() on KESm returned this Broker. Broker swaps call transferIn to burn the incoming Mento stable and transferOut to mint the outgoing stable only through registered exchanges subject to exchange and trading-limit checks.

controls.label: Mento Timelock - KESm token and Broker administrator
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, KESm owner(), token proxy owner, and Broker proxy owner returned this Timelock; getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. StableTokenV2 ownership can change broker, validators, and exchange authorization slots, while the proxy role can replace token and Broker mint-critical logic.

controls.label: Celo ValidatorsProxy - authorized KESm minter slot
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, validators() on KESm returned this proxy and StableTokenV2 admitted it through onlyMinter. The current Validators implementation can mint only Registry USDm to EpochManager and has no generic or KESm-targeting call, so the slot is authorized but cannot currently issue KESm.

controls.label: Celo GovernanceProxy - Validators proxy upgrade owner
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, ValidatorsProxy _getOwner() returned this GovernanceProxy and _getImplementation() returned 0x13B0B89F3242f815C1FC6C9CF56e1Ab5aEA4dC58. Governance can change the authorized proxy's implementation, creating a latent KESm mint path, but has no current direct KESm call.

review.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, KESm broker(), owner(), validators(), and exchange() returned the Mento Broker, two-day Mento Timelock, Celo ValidatorsProxy, and zero address respectively. Proxy introspection resolved the current token and Broker implementations and administrators. The Broker is the live swap mint/burn path; the current Validators implementation can only mint Registry USDm, while its Celo-Governance-owned proxy remains a latent upgrade-controlled authorization surface.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: KESm supply is confined to its canonical Celo deployment; the single reviewed route is native Mento Broker issuance against the shared Mento Reserve. No bridge route carries the claim.

routes.reviewNote: At finalized Celo block 72780426, KESm broker() returned the Mento Broker and the tracked token's 21,291,895.334248545419330280-unit supply was native to Celo. Pinned issuer configuration classifies KESm as reserve-backed and the deployment registry contains no KESm borrower branch. No bridge route carries the claim.

reserveReview.rationale: The prior single USDm-CDP dependency slice could not classify the live Mento adapter rows. Pinned issuer configuration resolves KESm as reserve-backed, and its adapter runs in broker-pool mode without a cdpStablecoin parameter, so the captured composition is the shared Mento Reserve basket. The envelope is restated on the adapter's exact constituent identities and 2026-07-27 captured weights from the issuer-run reserve analytics API, which now includes an ETH category (native ETH on Ethereum plus a residual Celo WETH balance, reported as one 'ETH' slice by the adapter); each stablecoin constituent links to its tracked asset, and CELO, stETH, and ETH carry explicit classification and failure-domain identity. The live adapter refreshes weights at runtime.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mento reserve analytics API constituent identities and weights captured 2026-07-27; KESm is reserve-backed per Mento's backing registry
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every constituent of the shared Mento Reserve captured by the live adapter is identified and either linked to a tracked stablecoin or explicitly classified. Constituent weights drift and are refreshed by the live adapter.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: CELO is the Celo network native asset held as external reserve collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
stETH is external liquid-staking collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
ETH is external cryptoasset collateral held by the Mento Reserve (native ETH on Ethereum plus a residual Celo WETH balance), not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserve assets are held in the on-chain Mento Reserve contract under Mento governance rather than with a legal custodian, so legal segregation, insolvency treatment, and reuse restrictions are not established by the reviewed sources; constituent-level custody (e.g. Circle, Tether, Lido) sits with each issuer.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: KES is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so KESm is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.
